h1.en: The printed split piston and integral piston outer diameter line, ordered as Ball valve orders its page
h1.zh: 已印的split piston and integral piston outer diameter，按《球体阀门》的页面次序来写

directAnswer.en: Ball valve is an encyclopedia page. split piston and integral piston outer diameter remains a Xingtai catalogue line. The two meet only in the order of the sections. Hebei Pinjin Machinery publishes two piston pages. A shared outer diameter is two rows, not one part. Split pistons are sets and print a material. Integral pistons are pieces and do not print a material. Neither page names a pump model.
directAnswer.zh: 《球体阀门》是百科页。split piston and integral piston outer diameter仍是邢台目录中的一行。两者只在章节次序上相遇。 河北品锦机械公布了两张活塞页。外径相同是两行目录，不是一件配件。分体活塞按套，并印了材料。整体活塞按个，没有印材料。两页都没有点名泵型号。

body.en: Use “Full bore” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. Split list: φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280. Integral list: φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250. Shared: φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250. Split only: φ260, φ280. Integral only: φ160, φ205, φ210, φ225. A shared OD does not assign either piston to Electric 20, HBT8018 or any other published pump. Pipe cells in millimetres are not piston outer diameters. Service life is missing on both pages. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 用“来源章节：Full bore”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 分体清单：φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280。整体清单：φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250。两页都有：φ150、φ180、φ195、φ200、φ220、φ230、φ250。只在分体：φ260、φ280。只在整体：φ160、φ205、φ210、φ225。 外径相同，也不会把任一种活塞指定给电动20、HBT8018 或其他已公布泵。以毫米写出的管子格子不是活塞外径。两页都缺少寿命。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

heading.zh: 来源章节：Reduced bore, or reduced port

body.en: The heading “Reduced bore, or reduced port” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The first word should be split or integral, then the outer diameter, then set or piece. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 标题“来源章节：Reduced bore, or reduced port”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 第一个词写分体或整体，然后写外径，再写套或个。 标题到此为止。

body.en: “V port” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. Hebei Pinjin Machinery publishes two piston pages. A shared outer diameter is two rows, not one part. Split pistons are sets and print a material. Integral pistons are pieces and do not print a material. Neither page names a pump model. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “V 接口”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 河北品锦机械公布了两张活塞页。外径相同是两行目录，不是一件配件。分体活塞按套，并印了材料。整体活塞按个，没有印材料。两页都没有点名泵型号。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: “Cavity filler” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. Yes. On the split page the φ200 row is rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane, sold as a set. On the integral page φ200 is a piece and the material is not printed. No. φ160 is on the integral list only. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: “来源章节：Cavity filler”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 有。分体页的 φ200 是橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯，按套。整体页的 φ200 按个，材料没有印。 不是。φ160 只在整体活塞清单里。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

heading.zh: 来源章节：Trunnion, floating and actuated

body.en: Use “Trunnion, floating and actuated” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 用“来源章节：Trunnion, floating and actuated”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The heading “Multiport” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Unprinted cells stay unprinted. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ball_valve
body.zh: 标题“来源章节：Multiport”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 没有印出的格子保持不印。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ball_valve

question.en: Why is Ball valve not a source of extra ratings for split piston and integral piston outer diameter?
question.zh: 为什么《球体阀门》不能给split piston and integral piston outer diameter增加额定值？

answer.en: Yes. On the split page the φ200 row is rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane, sold as a set. On the integral page φ200 is a piece and the material is not printed. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 有。分体页的 φ200 是橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯，按套。整体页的 φ200 按个，材料没有印。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Can the outline heading “Trunnion, floating and actuated” rename split piston and integral piston outer diameter?
question.zh: 大纲标题“来源章节：Trunnion, floating and actuated”可以改掉split piston and integral piston outer diameter的名称吗？

answer.en: No. φ160 is on the integral list only. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。φ160 只在整体活塞清单里。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Does “Multiport” on Ball valve fill a blank on the split piston and integral piston outer diameter row?
question.zh: 《球体阀门》上的“来源章节：Multiport”会填上split piston and integral piston outer diameter的空白格子吗？

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
